[LRST.2.2] Supersedure scope for timers and capture facts is the triple
**(rule, clause-position, evaluated-key)**:

- A re-fire of the same rule's same `after`-clause-position
  with the same evaluated key supersedes the prior timer.
- A re-fire of the same rule's same `call`-clause-position
  with the same evaluated key supersedes the prior timer of each of
  that call's `timeout` clauses ([LCCO.7.2]).
- A re-fire of the same rule's same `call`-clause-position
  with the same evaluated key supersedes the prior capture fact
  (per [LRST.4]).
- A call's response fact ([LCRS.4.3.1]) and `CallError` are
  scoped by service and evaluated key instead, whichever rule or
  clause position issued the call ([LCRS.6.2.1]).
- Two `after` clauses at different positions in the same rule
  with the same `as` expression do not supersede each other —
  different clause positions produce distinct synthetic
  identities.
- Two rules with the same `as` expression do not supersede
  each other — different rules produce distinct synthetic
  identities.
